describe: change the colours of the site
guide: Colours live in the variables in :root at the top of src/styles.css: --bg is the page, --ink the writing, --accent links and buttons, --card the boxes. Change the value there, not a colour written into one rule -- one change there changes the whole site.
There is a second :root inside @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark). Change it too, or the colour only shows in light mode.
Check the writing is still easy to read against the new background.
report: I made $part $colour ($hex) -- that is $var in styles.css, in light and dark mode. $note
$part is $colour now: $var went from $old to $hex, in both light and dark mode. $note
Done: $var is $hex, which is $colour, so $part $changes everywhere it is used. $note
teach: Every rule that says var($var) picks up the new value, which is why one line changes the whole site.
